title: DEATH NOTE: ANOTHER NOTE - THE LOS ANGELES BB MURDER CASES
author: NisiOisiN
thought: Not a spectacularly good novel but an okay one to spend some time into the world of Death Note gain. I kinda like the murder case here with those setups and puzzles but the narration made by Mello doesn't make sense to me at all. He was never the type of making diary or notes about something only to tell stories. He was more of an action on the spot guy. In my opinion, Roger Ruvie suits the role better and he is a man in the background and knowing everybody in Wammy's House. I hope we have more books on the cases mentioned in this book but again I don't recommend Mello as narrator.
